scenarios.name: probe
scenarios.detail: probe reached the real omp CLI; declared capabilities intact

scenarios.name: read_only_start_and_progress
scenarios.detail: real omp spawned on a PTY, VendorSessionEstablished observed, and >=1 normalized assistant message tailed from the vendor's own transcript

scenarios.name: follow_up
scenarios.detail: send(FollowUp) wrote composed bytes to the pty and a fresh normalized message was tailed back from the real CLI -- delivery mechanism proven end to end

scenarios.name: cancellation_scope
scenarios.detail: cancel(CancelScope::Worker) signalled termination and a ProcessExited was journaled once the exit watcher observed it

scenarios.name: session_resume
scenarios.detail: live mode: a single-process resume is not a daemon restart; transcript recovery across a real daemon restart is covered by a separate serve->stop->serve end-to-end smoke that has NOT yet run (tracked as post-0.5.0 follow-up). The vendor-free serve->status->stop smoke did pass in WP29.
